policies: What to Bring Come dressed and ready for the weather forecast and conditions Lake Superior and Mother Nature send our way. - Avoid black soled shoes.
Waves, wind, and weather all play a factor for each tour.
You are always welcome to apply your full payment toward another trip or request a refund.
There will be no refund within 48 hours.
Weather Cancellation Due to the seasonal nature of Lake Superior, weather can affect our operations.
If unpleasant weather causes a cancellation, you will be rescheduled or you will receive a full refund.
As long as the weather cooperates we will do our best to create the adventure of a lifetime on the big lake.
Time Out is equipped with current navigation equipment which allows us to sail in all types of weather conditions.
